messages:
deploy-bot: AUTOMATED ROLLBACK triggered for release v3.4.1 -> reason: p95 latency + 503 spike in us-west-2. Traffic shifted back to v3.3.9. Rollback mode: auto -> initiated.

mira (eng-releases): seeing it. p95 jumped to ~1.9s, errors ~4.2% over 15m. Do we let auto complete or switch to manual pin+hotfix?

sam (sre): quick look: increased KV cache miss rate and a few kernel-timeouts. Could be q8 quant flag regression. grabbing logs now.

mira (eng-releases): agree on q8-quant suspicion. My vote: abort auto rollback finish, perform manual rollback + preserve canary slice for postmortem.

deploy-bot: If manual rollback requested, recommended command:
```
releases rollback --to v3.3.9 --no-auto --reason "kvcache-compatibility"
# then pin: releases pin --version v3.3.9 --scope prod --note "emergency pin after v3.4.1 latency/503s"
```
Please also notify #prod-incidents and CS.

tony (product): +1 to manual rollback & pin. Need release-note blurb + CS outreach for Dedicated customers. @leah can you handle customer comms? Mark as high priority.

leah (customer-success): I will draft the short email and status page update. ETA ~12m. Will call out affected regions and that we rolled back to v3.3.9 while we investigate.

mira (eng-releases): ops checklist before executing manual rollback:
1) run the deploy-bot rollback command above
2) pin traffic 100% to v3.3.9
3) run smoke: `curl -f https://api.redwood.io/health` and a couple of representative endpoints
4) collect traces and kvcache metrics -> attach to postmortem ticket
5) notify customers & close loop

sam (sre): I'll run smoke tests and monitor tail of errors. Smoke command I'll use: `for u in /v1/generate /v1/embeddings; do curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.io$u; done`

mira (eng-releases): executing manual rollback in 60s unless objections. Will record timeline in #inc-4021.

tony (product): no objections from product. Make sure release notes include rollback reason and mitigation plan.

mira (eng-releases): executing now.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE -> target v3.3.9. Traffic pinned. Healthchecks PASS. p95 reduced to ~310ms; errors <0.5%. Incident thread created: #inc-4021.

leah (customer-success): Customer emails sent to Dedicated contacts; status page updated. Paired with templated note + link to incident thread. :white_check_mark:

mira (eng-releases): assigning postmortem owners: mira + sam + infra lead. Next steps: add regression test for q8-quant flag in canary gate, and block v3.4.x variants until compatibility verified. Closing this thread after we open the postmortem ticket. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
